10.summary:
## Mother's Day Beauty Event — Executive Report

The Mother's Day Beauty Event (MDC-2026-MD-001) targeted Beauty Enthusiasts aged 25–54, primarily Macy's Star Rewards Gold and Platinum members with prior Beauty purchase history. The campaign offered up to 25% off across skincare, fragrance, and cosmetics, supplemented by a free gift with $75+ purchases and free shipping on Beauty orders over $50. Total campaign budget was $1.8M across paid media ($1.2M), store experience ($400K), and email/CRM ($200K).

The 10-step workflow executed cleanly. Segmentation in Step 2 identified 3 segments from a pool of 45,000 customers, with Beauty Enthusiasts 25–54 selected as the primary target. Step 3 locked 6 SKUs from an initial recommendation of 18, with the pricing check confirming zero MAP conflicts across all selected products. Creative production in Step 4 sourced 12 DAM assets with active rights across all four target regions (NY, CA, FL, TX), and Step 5 generated layout copy for web banner, email, mobile, and in-store signage placements.

Compliance pre-check at Step 6 passed with two warnings: the tagline "Beauty She Deserves" requires Brand Marketing Council review as it falls outside the pre-approved tagline list, and the "Up to 25% off" claim needs the FTC-required "starting at" minimum disclosure added. Despite these warnings, the VP approved the campaign for launch. Localization in Step 7 produced 4 regional variants covering English and Spanish, and activation in Step 8 scheduled deployment across email, paid social, display, and in-store channels.

Performance results exceeded all primary targets. Campaign revenue reached $4.8M against a $4.2M target (14% above plan), ROAS came in at 3.8x versus the 3.5x goal, email open rate hit 28% (above the 22% target), and the team acquired 5,200 new Beauty customers, surpassing the 5,000+ acquisition goal. These results compare favorably to the Spring 2025 Beauty retro (RETRO-SP-2025-BTY), which delivered $42.1M revenue at a 4.2x ROAS, and the Q4 2025 Holiday campaign (RETRO-Q4-2025), where Beauty Loyalists outperformed plan by 23%.
